subject: Insurance
title: Insuring a Movie Star's Legs
description: Learn Insuring a Movie Star's Legs in one minute.

hook.text: Betty Grable insured her legs for $1 million in 1943—$18 million today.

buildup.text: 20th Century Fox paid the premium. Her legs were a studio asset generating millions at the box office.

discovery.text: Grable's policy was the first celebrity body-part insurance to make headlines. It invented a new marketing category.

twist.text: The Guinness Book of World Records listed her legs as the most valuable in the world.

climax.text: Grable proved that insuring a star's feature creates its own publicity. The policy paid for itself in press coverage.

punchline.text: $1 million legs in 1943. Betty Grable invented celebrity insurance.

quiz.question: Why did Betty Grable's leg insurance make history?
options: First celebrity body-part insurance to become a marketing tool
